text:
Situation: Liraglutide injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-07-18 and remains current as of 2026-10-14 for Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Novo Nordisk Inc. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. is listed as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-05-14 and related information stating discontinuation of manufacture. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 39 months. Corvale East holds 64 units at 7.4 units per day providing 9 days on hand while Corvale General holds 62 units at 4.4 units per day providing 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows liraglutide injection shortage current since 2023-07-18 for Hikma, Meitheal, and Novo Nordisk. Teva listed as To Be Discontinued posted 2026-05-14 with discontinuation of manufacture noted.

Our position: Inventory covers 9 to 14 days depending on site. No current supply from listed shortage manufacturers. Alternative suppliers not on FDA's shortage list exist but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Biocon Pharma Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Cipla USA Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate Hybio Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Pingshan Factory) product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Lupin Pharmaceuticals, Inc. product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate NorthStar Rx LLC product for purchase; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or therapeutic substitution recommendations; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
